posts.text: We inherited a broken economy and we're fixing it. Better EU relations, stabilised finances, reduced NHS waiting times. The policy choices are being vindicated. I'm not planning to step down — there's too much work still to do.

posts.text: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp, but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back at some point.

posts.text: AI is transforming how people connect and create. We're building the tools to make that possible at scale — from open-source models to AI glasses. The future of computing is ambient, personal, and intelligent.

posts.text: Excited about the AI breakthroughs we're shipping at Google. From Gemini to Search to Cloud — AI is becoming a core part of everything we build. The pace of innovation has never been faster.

posts.text: 2026 is the defining year for AI at scale. We're moving from experimentation to real enterprise adoption — AI is now enhancing productivity and decision-making across every industry. The key is responsible development with humans at the center.
posts.caption: 2026 is the defining year for AI at scale. We're moving from experimentation to real enterprise adoption — AI is now enhancing productivity and decision-making across every industry. The key is responsible development with humans at the center.

posts.text: I'm delighted to be wrong about this. I thought there would have been more impact on entry-level, white-collar jobs being eliminated by now than has actually happened. AI won't cause a 'jobs apocalypse' — the human part of work is irreplaceable.
